_instructions: HOW TO ADD A POST: 1) Add your category names as strings inside 'categories', e.g. ["Essays", "Travel"]. 2) Copy the '_postTemplate' object below, paste it inside the 'posts' array, and fill in the fields. 3) Set 'featured': true on exactly one post to pin it as the main story on the home page. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the site.
